title: Universal Command History With Real Backwards For Every Command
description:
Extend the framework command-history panel (built in a prior ticket) so it captures every interaction, not just VCS-edit-producing operations. Reported bug: in the aggregator app (puzzle plugin, app puzzle3d-play), zooming/panning/dragging leaves the history empty. Root causes verified: (1) zoom/pan/orbit camera lives in ephemeral React/wgpu state and never reaches the plugin at all (the one escaping signal, noteWorldNavigation, is explicitly swallowed by the shell); (2) View/Shell-kind actions that DO reach the plugin (setCamera on 2D hosts, setActiveUtility, etc.) are dropped from the log because dispatch_emit early-returns before logging when no VCS operations are produced; (3) drag-drop actions already log but can render stale because narrow UiDirtyScope::Partial scopes never include the history panel body key.

Approved design (see full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-app-must-show-mighty-pearl.md): (D1) log every command that reaches the plugin, View and Shell kinds included, with edit_id: None; (D2) unify camera to View-kind, session-only, everywhere — move camera storage out of document projections in puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity, etc., so undo never reverts camera and it stops being a VCS edit; (D3) add a new framework-injected noteShellCommand {commandId, label, detail?} action so shell chrome commands (dock drag, window resize/close, theme/locale changes) get logged too; (D4) consecutive same-id View/Shell log rows fold into one entry with a ×count instead of flooding the panel; (D5) trinity's GraphFixture.camera stays as a seed-only DSL field (consumed once on load, never written back).

Executed via a multi-agent Workflow (four phases): WF-A core mechanism (framework core injected action + plugin crate recording tail, sequential since plugin depends on core's new constants), WF-B app-crate camera-out-of-document sweep (parallel fan-out across ~14 disjoint app crates: puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity jack/rewrite/ram, architect, cad, fem 2d/3d, shooting, writer, sequence, mathematical, lowpoly), WF-C renderer routing (React + native wgpu renderer, parallel — camera dispatch wiring, noteShellCommand dispatch seams), WF-D integration verify + aggregator end-to-end browser check. Hard cutover per repo convention — no compatibility shims, no migrations; camera ops are deleted from affected op crates and any fixtures hand-fixed.
summary:
Landed the foundational real-backwards mechanism on top of this ticket's already-shipped log-only base (record_command/push_log_entry/log_generation/noteShellCommand, all verified pre-existing and left untouched), plus one isolated VCS-bypass fix. Full fleet-wide retrofit across ~50 app crates / 292 view_actions / 39 shell_actions is NOT done — this session proves the mechanism end-to-end and closes one concrete gap; see Remaining below.

Implemented:
- New `InverseAction { action_id, args }` (🧰framework/…/🔌plugin/…/📦lib.rs) — a stored, replayable inverse for a View/Shell-kind command, memory-only, never persisted.
- `CommandLogEntry`/`CommandView` gained `inverse: Option<InverseAction>`; `revertible` is now true either via the existing edit-linked VCS path OR a stored `inverse` — no UI change needed, `ui_history_panel`'s per-row Backwards button already gated on `revertible`.
- `ActionEmit` gained `inverse: Option<InverseAction>` + `ActionEmit::view_with_inverse(...)` constructor — a View-kind action computes its own inverse from state it already holds (e.g. previous selection/camera) and hands it back; `record_command`/`push_log_entry` thread it through, preserving the ORIGINAL inverse across folded "×N" rows (backwards on a folded row must undo the whole run, not just the last dispatch).
- `revertToCommand` now branches three ways: edit-linked (unchanged VCS undo-to-position), View-kind memory-only (replays the inverse locally via `dispatch_action`, which logs its own new/folded row — append-only, "backwards of backwards" naturally redoes), Shell-kind memory-only (the plugin has no access to shell-owned state, so it bubbles a new `HostEffect::ReplayShellCommand { action_id, args }` for the shell to redispatch through its own command funnel — verified the new HostEffect variant is safe repo-wide, both consumer match arms (wgpu, plugin) already carry a wildcard `_ => {}`).
- `noteShellCommand` accepts optional `inverseCommandId`/`inverseArgs` so a shell call site can supply a real inverse.
- Two new plugin tests prove both paths end-to-end: `view_action_with_inverse_is_revertible_and_backwards_restores_app_runtime_state`, `shell_action_with_inverse_bubbles_a_replay_effect_instead_of_replaying_locally`. Full suite: 131 plugin tests + 99 core tests green (was 129/99 before, no regressions).
- Verified every `ActionEmit { ... }` literal repo-wide already spreads `..Default::default()`, so the new field is compile-safe everywhere without touching call sites.
- Isolated VCS-bypass fix (frozen contract ticket 26/07/28/DOCUMENT-COMMAND-DSL-OP-STORE-ARCHITECTURE gap G8): note app's `PutAsset` inverted to a whole-document `SetDocument` snapshot, which would wrongly revert every other pending change. Added `NoteOperation::RemoveAsset { key }`; `PutAsset`'s backwards is now composed (restores the prior asset at that key, or removes the key if it didn't exist before); `RemoveAsset`'s backwards restores what was removed (empty inverse if the key was already absent). 3 note-op tests green including a new one proving an unrelated field survives the round-trip (the snapshot inverse would have clobbered it).

Deliberately NOT touched (would have raced or duplicated a concurrent live workforce mid-execution on the same files — the React shell renderer file had a ~6-minute-old mtime at session start): fleet-wide retrofit of real inverses across the ~50 app crates' 292 view_actions/39 shell_actions (only one exemplar app, the plugin's own `TestApp`, got a real inverse); wiring `HostEffect::ReplayShellCommand` consumption in the React/wgpu shell renderers (the shell call sites that dispatch `noteShellCommand` — theme/locale/dock/panel — don't yet supply `inverseCommandId`/`inverseArgs`, so Shell rows are revertible in the type system but nothing redispatches the bubbled effect yet); space-catalog CRUD → real OsOperation/SHomeOperation-backed VCS (confirmed `SetCatalogGeneration` counter hack and `STUDIO_PORTS`/`EPHEMERAL_STUDIOS` globals still exist, unchanged); native wgpu `handle_command` RPC bridge gap; CAD's parallel `DocumentHistory` in its TS core. These remain open follow-up work — recommend a fresh ticket per gap given the scope and the live concurrent-workforce risk on the shared hot files (plugin/core/React-shell/wgpu-shell lib.rs).
